runtimeProof.meaning: New JumpToAction initializes its tracking latch at +70 to true.
Tracking compares current vertical direction times current speed against minSpeedTracking; below threshold clears +70 and returns.
Reads target motion and target-position query for the retained target handle. The MC target-center and grounded velocity adapter is explicit below.
Lerps trackingMin/Max using charge; this FIG sets both to 50. Calls 101265b0 with current direction, current speed, delta time, rate, dot cutoff 0, prediction true, no fallback flag.

Quadratic intercept uses a=dot(vTarget,vTarget)-speed^2, b=2*dot(target-self,vTarget), c=distance^2; positive root t=2*c/(sqrt(b*b-4*a*c)-b) produces target+vTarget*t. Nonpositive solution falls back to target position.

Predicted direction dot current direction must exceed zero. Otherwise false is returned without turning. For a valid direction the rotation angle is at most rate*dt and the direction is normalized; no speed is added.
Return value becomes tracking latch +70; passing the target does not allow a later U-turn/reacquisition in the same action.
Action update first applies tracking, then multiplies direction by current speed, subtracts gravity*dt from Y and normalizes/stores new speed.

implemented: One committed target throughout the leap, now with finite 3D airborne tracking instead of hard-locked trajectory.
50 degrees/second becomes 2.5 degrees per 20 Hz tick; current speed is preserved and native-style intercept prediction is bounded by the angular limit.
Passing the target (predicted dot <= 0) latches tracking off; no target swap, restart or repeated leap loop is introduced.
The block-person body yaw follows horizontal flight direction. Wrist contact interpolates previous/current yaw with the same Mth.rotLerp path as the renderer, including crossing +/-180.

Next-step swept bounds plus collision-query border require every covered chunk to be loaded. Unknown terrain stops velocity and aborts. Side/ceiling obstacles, new line-of-sight cover, protected/vehicle targets abort the action before damage.
minecraftAdaptations: Target position is its receiving AABB center; grounded target velocity has its residual MC gravity component removed. This is not claimed to reproduce native position-query submode 2.

Source minSpeedTracking=-100 is expressed as -5 blocks/tick using one source distance unit to one block for this speed gate. Existing jump initial velocity, MC gravity/drag, fixed entry range and timeout remain the previous explicit adapters. Full native launch-angle/speed/gravity code is NOT ported by this patch.

Line-of-sight, consumption/vehicle invalidation and loaded-chunk checks are MC safety rules, not claimed to be recovered native JumpTo abort rules. Vanilla collision owns actual movement; the AI never calls move or teleports for tracking.
Native tracking changes 3D velocity. Keeping the upright authored block-person facing aligned to horizontal velocity and using its right wrist is an MC rig adaptation.

No new source animation or sound asset was imported. Release hash f690459128de52ce and land hash 617db94293869beb are absent from the 24 clips in the current infected2_all package; full source clip resolution and landing bone retarget remain pending.
